user_intent.original_question: 查询克里斯托弗·诺兰（Christopher Nolan）导演的电影的平均评分（average_rating）

business_rules.name: 评分可信度
business_rules.condition: 排名类查询应加 num_votes > 10000 过滤

historical_qa_pairs.original_question: 导演-演员黄金搭档分析，找出合作 3 次以上且合作作品平均评分 >= 7.5 的导演-演员组合
historical_qa_pairs.sql_query: SELECT d.primary_name AS director_name, a.primary_name AS actor_name, COUNT(*) AS collaboration_count, ROUND(AVG(t.average_rating), 2) AS avg_rating FROM principals pd JOIN titles t ON pd.title_id = t.id AND t.title_type = 'movie' JOIN principals pa ON pa.title_id = t.id AND pa.category_id IN ('actor', 'actress') JOIN names d ON pd.name_id = d.id JOIN names a ON pa.name_id = a.id WHERE pd.category_id = 'director' AND t.num_votes > 5000 AND t.average_rating IS NOT NULL GROUP BY d.id, d.primary_name, a.id, a.primary_name HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3 AND AVG(t.average_rating) >= 7.5 ORDER BY collaboration_count DESC, avg_rating DESC LIMIT 20

knowledge.content: titles ←→ principals ←→ names 核心路径：作品通过 principals 关联人物，principals.category_id = 'director' 表示导演
titles.average_rating 为 IMDb 加权平均评分(1.0-10.0)，titles.title_type='movie' 表示电影
导演的 category_id = 'director'，不要用 job_id 来查导演（job 是自由格式，不标准）
